node_definition.done_when: Done when a new tests/test_an_unpersisted_report_expires.py shows, on a synthetic crew home with a mounted synthetic project: An unreferenced item 31 days old is removed. A 29-day-old item attributed by folder name is kept until its plan closes, and is removed once it does. The same holds for a 29-day-old item attributed only through a ledger run's report path. A 29-day-old item that matches neither rule is kept whatever any plan's status. A 31-day-old item attributed to a plan that is still open is removed, because the 30-day ceiling applies whichever way the item is attributed. Each of these is kept at 90 days: a persisted item; an item whose own path is cited in a plan document; an item cited only through a file inside it; one item cited only from a research document, and another only from an evidence fragment; and an item named by a live pointer. No reckon-written folder is removed whole at any age. A 31-day-old unreferenced child of code-review is removed. The plan-review folder's contents are left to its own rule. An expired symlinked item has its target and its symlink removed. A symlink whose target lies outside the permitted roots is kept and reported. The dry run's candidate list equals the set --apply removes. A 40-day-old run-keyed tree that holds a figure a plan cites is kept, where at the base revision _run_report_trees removes it. Three negative controls: dropping the citation check removes the cited item and fails the test; matching citations against the item's own path only removes the item cited through a file inside it and fails the test; dropping the target-root check removes the outside target and fails the test. The test files that import reckon.crew.gc add no failure against the base revision, and the test asserts the real crew home is untouched. Ruff adds no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/report_retention.py (new); reckon/crew/routing.py , where _run_report_trees runs; reckon/crew/gc.py ; the flight schema, for the staging-root field; and the new test. After the node lands, the coordinator measures the real store. The node cannot do this step, because its write scope is the reckon repository and the settings live in other repositories. Set the staging root in each moved project's own flight configuration: /work/projects/imas_gpu/crew-reports/imas-efit for imas-efit and /work/projects/imas_gpu/crew-reports/nova for nova. Each is committed in its own repository. Run one dry run over the real reports store on the fleet node, under a 30-minute timeout. Record whether it finished and, per project, the count and bytes it would expire. The dry run must report none of the moved imas-efit or nova folders as outside the permitted roots. Each moved folder is either a candidate, or kept with a citation, persist or live-pointer reason. The record is committed as docs/evidence/fragments/a-report-is-kept-only-when-persisted/an-unpersisted-report-expires.html . The section is declared done only once that record shows the dry run finished inside its timeout.
